kit_page.name: props_kit
kit_page.summary: Enroll an object as a prop, lay out its path nodes, then drive it, optionally adding spin, hover, rock or shuttle motion.

kit_row.help: Right-click an object > Director > Path Object, or select it and press Enroll. Then move the prop, drop nodes and Drive.
kit_row.label: Tip
kit_row.text: Right-click an object > Director > Path Object, or select it and press Enroll. Move the prop, drop nodes, then Drive.

kit_row.help: Enroll the selected object's root as a prop you can drive. Select it with right-click or the edit tool first.
kit_row.keywords: enroll add prop object selected in-world
kit_row.label: Enroll object

button.name: btn_enroll
button.label: Enroll selected object
button.tool_tip: Enroll the in-world selection's linkset ROOT as a drivable prop (select it with right-click or the edit tool first)

kit_row.help: Enrolled props. Away means the object is not resolvable right now (out of range or derezzed).
kit_row.label: Props

scroll_list.name: prop_list
scroll_list.tool_tip: Enrolled props. The name fills in from the object's properties (fetched when you selected it); away = the object is not currently resolvable (out of interest range or derezzed)

kit_row.help: Un-enroll the selected prop. Its authored path is dropped too.
kit_row.label: Remove

button.name: prop_btn_remove
button.label: Remove
button.tool_tip: Un-enroll the selected prop. Its authored path is dropped too

kit_row.help: How many props are enrolled and how many are driving.
kit_row.label: Status

kit_row.help: The selected prop's path nodes. Select one to tune its skid and speed below.
kit_row.label: Nodes

scroll_list.name: node_list
scroll_list.tool_tip: The selected prop's path nodes. Select one to tune its skid yaw and speed override below

kit_row.help: Add a node at the prop's current position. Drag the prop between adds to lay out the route.
kit_row.label: Add node

button.name: btn_node_add
button.label: Add node here
button.tool_tip: Append a path node at the prop's CURRENT position (drag the prop with the edit tool between adds to lay out the route)

kit_row.help: Delete the selected node, or the last node when none is selected.
kit_row.label: Delete node

button.name: btn_node_del
button.label: Delete node
button.tool_tip: Delete the selected node (the last node when none is selected)

kit_row.help: Stop the drive and remove every node of the selected prop. It stays enrolled.
kit_row.label: Clear path

button.name: btn_node_clear
button.label: Clear path
button.tool_tip: Stop the drive and drop every node of the selected prop (it stays enrolled)

kit_row.help: Yaw offset from the travel direction at the selected node, to fake a skid or drift. Plus is counter-clockwise.
kit_row.keywords: skid yaw heading turn node degrees
kit_row.label: Skid (deg)

spinner.name: node_skid_spin
spinner.tool_tip: Yaw offset from the travel direction as the drive passes the selected node: fake a skid or drift through a corner. + is counter-clockwise

kit_row.help: Local speed at the selected node. 0 uses the path speed; ramp nodes to fake acceleration or braking.
kit_row.keywords: node speed override metres per second
kit_row.label: Node m/s

spinner.name: node_speed_spin
spinner.tool_tip: Local speed override at the selected node (0 = use the path speed). Ramp node speeds to fake acceleration or braking

kit_row.help: Drive the selected prop along its path. Needs at least two nodes. Other viewers see the prop parked.
kit_row.label: Drive

button.name: btn_drive
button.label: Drive
button.tool_tip: Drive the selected prop along its path (needs at least 2 nodes). Client-side only: other viewers see the prop parked

kit_row.help: Release the selected prop's drive. It stays where the drive left it until the next server update.
kit_row.label: Stop

button.name: prop_btn_stop
button.label: Stop
button.tool_tip: Release the selected prop's drive; it stays rendered where the drive left it until the next server update

kit_row.help: Drive every enrolled prop that has a drivable path.
kit_row.label: Drive all

button.name: btn_drive_all
button.label: Drive all
button.tool_tip: Drive every enrolled prop that has a drivable path

kit_row.help: Release every drive.
kit_row.label: Stop all

kit_row.help: Nominal drive speed along the whole path, in metres per second. Per-node speeds still win locally.
kit_row.keywords: path speed velocity metres per second
kit_row.label: Path m/s

spinner.name: path_speed_spin
spinner.tool_tip: Nominal drive speed along the whole path (per-node overrides win locally)

kit_row.help: What happens at the last node: hold there, loop back to the start, or ping-pong the route.
kit_row.keywords: last node end loop ping-pong stop repeat
kit_row.label: At last node

combo_box.name: prop_end_mode_combo
combo_box.tool_tip: What happens at the last node: hold there, loop back to the start, or ping-pong the route

kit_row.help: Store the prop's current world rotation into the selected node. Used by Authored and Face path + offset.
kit_row.label: Capture Orient

button.name: btn_capture_orient
button.label: Capture Orient
button.tool_tip: Store the prop's CURRENT world rotation into the selected node (used by the Authored / Face path + offset rotation modes below)

kit_row.help: How the drive turns the prop: Face path follows travel; Authored uses captured node rotations; Face path + offset adds a twist.
kit_row.keywords: orient orientation rotation face path authored offset
kit_row.label: Orient mode

combo_box.name: rotation_mode_combo
combo_box.tool_tip: How the drive orients the prop: Face path (default) faces the travel tangent + skid; Authored slerps the captured per-node orientations; Face path + offset applies a captured orientation as an extra twist/tilt on top of the tangent facing

kit_card.name: kc_hover
kit_card.enable_tooltip: Bob the prop up/down in place on a sine wave, on top of whatever the path is doing
kit_card.title: Hover

kit_row.help: Full is a plain sine, up and down. Half is rectified: always up from the base, for a bounce or pulse.
kit_row.keywords: hover bob wave shape full half
kit_row.label: Shape

combo_box.name: hover_wave_combo
combo_box.tool_tip: Full = plain sine (up and down); Half = rectified sine (always up from the base, a bounce/pulse feel)

kit_row.help: Hover height in metres.
kit_row.label: Amp (m)

kit_row.help: Hover frequency in cycles per second.
kit_row.label: Speed (Hz)

kit_card.name: kc_rock
kit_card.enable_tooltip: Rock/tilt the prop back and forth on a sine wave, on top of whatever the path is doing
kit_card.title: Rock

kit_row.help: Which local axes the rock drives: X is roll; X+Y adds pitch; X+Y+Z adds yaw.
kit_row.keywords: rock sway tilt axes roll pitch
kit_row.label: Axes

combo_box.name: rock_axis_combo
combo_box.tool_tip: Which local axes the rock angle drives: X only (roll), X+Y (roll+pitch), or X+Y+Z (roll+pitch+yaw)

kit_row.help: Rock angle in degrees.
kit_row.label: Amp (deg)

kit_row.help: Rock frequency in cycles per second.
kit_row.label: Speed (Hz)

kit_card.name: kc_spin
kit_card.enable_tooltip: Continuously spin the prop about one local axis, on top of whatever the path is doing
kit_card.title: Spin

kit_row.help: The local axis the prop spins about.
kit_row.label: Axis

combo_box.name: spin_axis_combo
combo_box.tool_tip: Which local axis to spin about

kit_row.help: Spin rate in degrees per second. Negative reverses the direction.
kit_row.keywords: spin rotation speed degrees per second
kit_row.label: Deg/s

spinner.name: spin_speed_spin
spinner.tool_tip: Spin rate, degrees per second (negative reverses direction)

kit_row.help: Build a straight back-and-forth path from the prop's position along the chosen axis and drive it. Replaces the prop's path.
kit_row.keywords: shuttle back and forth build path
kit_row.label: Shuttle

button.name: btn_shuttle
button.label: Shuttle
button.tool_tip: Build a straight ping-pong path at the prop's current position along the chosen axis and start driving it (replaces any existing path on this prop)

kit_row.help: World axis to shuttle along: X is east-west, Y north-south, Z up-down, XZ a slope set by Slope.
kit_row.keywords: shuttle axis direction x y z
kit_row.label: Axis

combo_box.name: shuttle_axis_combo
combo_box.tool_tip: World axis to shuttle along: X (east/west), Y (north/south), Z (straight up/down), or XZ (a sloped ramp -- see Slope)

kit_row.help: Direction along the chosen axis: plus or minus.
kit_row.label: Direction

kit_row.help: Total shuttle travel distance in metres, from the prop's current position.
kit_row.label: Distance (m)

spinner.name: shuttle_distance_spin
spinner.tool_tip: Total shuttle travel distance, metres, from the prop's current position

kit_row.help: Shuttle drive speed in metres per second.
kit_row.label: Speed (m/s)

spinner.name: shuttle_speed_spin
spinner.tool_tip: Shuttle drive speed, metres per second

kit_row.help: Ramp angle from horizontal on the XZ axis: 0 is flat along X, 90 is straight up.
kit_row.label: Slope (deg)

spinner.name: shuttle_slope_spin
spinner.tool_tip: XZ axis only: ramp angle from horizontal (0 = flat along X, 90 = straight up Z)
